description: This file defines the CandidateAttachmentModel class within the Recruitment API module of the OrangeHRM system. It implements methods for serialization and data filtering related to candidate attachments, encapsulating data such as ID, candidate ID, and attachment file properties.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing candidate attachment data in the recruitment module API, implementing Normalizable and utilizing traits for model behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a RecruitmentAttachment DTO and sets up filtering and attribute mappings.
